The circle of love and trust
entries.text: The healthy state of a relationship, with God or anyone, in which love is freely given and freely returned; the first domino is its breaking.

entries.title: The lie
entries.text: Satan's original claim about God, told in heaven and in Eden: that you will not die from sin, that God is withholding, and that his law is an imposed rule-set h

entries.title: The lie (the Eden form)
entries.text: The five words of Genesis 3:4, which Jennings reads as the thread running through every later distortion of God.

entries.title: Fear and selfishness
entries.text: What floods in once love and trust are broken: the self-protective drive that replaces other-centred love as the heart's governing motive.

entries.title: Survival of the fittest
entries.text: Jennings' name for fear and selfishness as a principle of life, the polar opposite of giving love; the Remedy paraphrases it at Romans 8:7.

entries.title: Acts of sin as symptoms
entries.text: Sinful behaviours are not the disease but its signs; they are the inevitable output of a heart already governed by fear and selfishness.

entries.title: Terminal condition
entries.text: The state of a mind, character and body damaged by acts of selfishness; without divine intervention it ends in death, because sin itself, not God, kills.

entries.title: The truth about God
entries.text: God's character as revealed in the life and death of Jesus; the first step and the only solvent that dissolves the lie and reopens trust.

entries.title: Trust
entries.text: The reopened heart: the response to truth about God that lets his love in and lets us stop protecting self.

entries.title: Conversion
entries.text: The switch of the heart's primary motive from survival-of-the-fittest selfishness to other-centred love; instant in principle, healed out over time.

entries.title: The law of love
entries.text: God's design law for life: the principle of selfless giving on which all reality is built to run; to live out of harmony with it is to break down and die.

entries.title: Design law versus imposed law

entries.title: Healing substitution
entries.text: Jennings' alternative to penal substitution: Christ took our condition to cure it in humanity, not to absorb a punishment God had to inflict.

entries.title: Legitimate and illegitimate guilt
entries.text: Legitimate guilt follows a real wrong and is resolved by repentance; illegitimate guilt always comes from a believed lie and is resolved only by truth.

entries.text: Rules made up by an authority and enforced by inflicted punishment, the way human governments work; Jennings' name for the mindset of levels one to four.

entries.title: Design law

entries.title: Law of exertion
entries.text: Strength comes by exertion: whatever is exercised grows and whatever is unused withers, which is why moral growth cannot be given, only practised.

entries.title: Law of liberty
entries.text: Love can exist only where there is freedom; coerce someone and love is damaged, rebellion instilled and individuality eroded.

entries.title: Law of worship
entries.text: By beholding we are changed: we become like the God we actually worship, so the character we ascribe to God shapes our own.

entries.title: At-one-ment
entries.text: Atonement read as at-one-ment: the restoration of complete unity between God and his creation, which is how level seven understands the cross.

entries.title: Sealed / sealing
entries.text: Being so settled into the truth and love of God, in understanding and experience, that nothing can move you; Jennings equates this with level seven.

entries.title: Restraining power
entries.text: Force used to limit harm (a parent grabbing a child near the road, a quarantine); it protects but cannot transform, so eventually it lets go.

entries.title: Servant vs friend (Maxwell)

entries.title: Failure to thrive
entries.text: Jennings' medical image for believers whose growth stops at level four because they take God's law to be imposed rules like human law.

entries.title: Fear is for children
entries.text: God meets immature people with warnings and even threats because that is what they can hear, but fear is a stage to grow out of, not the goal.

entries.text: The state of being out of harmony with God's law of love: a heart ruled by distrust, fear and selfishness, inherited since Adam and fatal if not cured.

entries.title: Sins (the symptoms)
entries.text: The acts: lying, lust, anger, adultery, murder. Real and damaging, but produced by the condition the way fever is produced by infection.
